verdict.rationale: Server-rendered components that fetch data and pass it to interactive client components are a fair question for a web framework like Angular, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only signals, components, DI, CLI commands and community opinions; nothing documents SSR, async server components, or server-to-client data handoff. Component inputs (@Input) are ordinary client-side data passing and do not count.

support.subject: As a developer, I can fetch data in asynchronous server-rendered components and pass it down to interactive client components
